title: Verified External Implementation Route — Qwen Code #13241
purpose: Provide a compact, independently inspectable route into an already-public third-party AI-tooling implementation chain without treating implementation, merge, release distribution, usage, endorsement, or whole-theory adoption as the same state.

case.source_relation: The receiver-authored PR explicitly states that the current revision implements the option-A recommendation from @Nakagawa-master, while separately clarifying that this was an external contributor recommendation rather than a repository-maintainer ruling.
implemented_distinction: Matching lease or attempt lineage is not by itself proof that an exact result was accepted.
An accepted exact result can be distinguished with a persisted receipt or equivalent durable acceptance fact.

After recovery or cancellation terminalizes an attempt, the old attempt does not retain authority to mutate the terminal answer, parent outcome, or execution-budget state merely because historical lineage identifiers still match.

evidence_stages.meaning: The receiver PR explicitly references the scoped @Nakagawa-master recommendation and contains receiver-authored code and tests implementing the bounded distinction.

The receiver PR points to Web Shell and native daemon/Host regression evidence covering accepted-result replay and refusal of late results after cancellation/recovery without mutating the settled execution-budget state.
The receiver implementation was merged on 2026-10-04.
After merge, the same receiver independently re-checked current main, described the fixed behavior, and explicitly referred again to option A picked by @Nakagawa-master in the #13241 review thread.
The non-prerelease v0.25.0 release notes explicitly list PR #13241.

Qwen Code Desktop v0.25.0 release notes explicitly list #13241, and the TypeScript SDK v0.1.18 states that it bundles CLI 0.25.0. This establishes receiver-owned distribution carry, not use of the specific behavior by an independent end user.

portable_test.question: Can a terminalized or superseded execution attempt still change current state merely because an old lease, attempt, worker, or lineage identifier matches?
minimal_cases: Accept one exact result, replay that exact result, and distinguish idempotent acknowledgement from a fresh write.
Cancel or recover the attempt before a late result arrives and verify that the late result cannot change terminal output or live execution-budget state.
Reclaim attempt N as N+1 and verify that N cannot mutate N+1 or current state.
Remove or revoke the executing worker and verify that historical identifiers do not recreate present authority.
portable_test.useful_non_fit_or_counterexample: A system may show that this distinction adds no practical value if terminalization transactionally prevents all later physical work and no stale or superseded actor can submit a state-changing result. Report that as non-fit rather than forcing the pattern.

optional_public_return.rule: Return only public, non-confidential evidence. Preserve proposal, response, implementation, merge, release, operational use, and adoption as separate stages.

evidence_boundary: This route concentrates already-public evidence. The strongest stages established here are receiver-side implementation, merge, later same-receiver Origin rereference, stable release inclusion, and receiver-owned product/package distribution carry. It does not convert those stages into independent end-user use, audience scale, whole-theory adoption, membership, or execution authority.
